reviews.comment: Dr. Bishop is an outstanding professor and really wants his students to LEARN, not just memorize information. 475 is challenging but I learned a LOT and I'm glad I took it. He is a great lecturer, and even though the subject matter is really advanced, if you GO TO CLASS (!!!), ask questions, take super detailed notes, and study, you will do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bishop is extremely knowledgeable about the subject he teaches, which can come across as intimidating and difficult to understand.  However, if you attend every lecture, ask questions for clarification, and study HARD, you will get a lot out of this class.  It is by no means easy, but ended up being very rewarding.

reviews.comment: Let me clear, you MAY pass if you dont go to class all that regularly, Dr. Bishop makes things harder than they need to be, hes not very easy to follow in lecture, he doesnt provide much in the notes - sometimes whats there is good - but hes all about being in class, often hell mention things ONLY in class, Labs are long and frustrating.

reviews.comment: I actually enjoyed this class this semester. I feel like I learned a ton. Dr. Bishop talks about a lot of concepts youve never heard about, but Id say thats a good thing. But dont get me wrong, you have to work hard in this class to do well. You cannot slack off. Do yourself a favor and stay ahead when you can, from the start. Good luck!

reviews.comment: Dr. Bishop is a tough professor. He expects you to pay very close attention to lectures and ask questions if you need clarification. Tests are very detail oriented, and you will probably fail if you regularly miss lecture (they are NOT recorded). Expect to spend upwards of 10 hours on each lab (4 this semester). You need to work hard to do well.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bishop is probably the toughest professor in the entire department. His tests are challenging and require you to really understand the material.
